use: Industry context injected into BTI builder instructions; independent of any single use case.

finance.name: Financial services
constraints: KYC/AML screening flags
PCI DSS masking of card numbers
model-risk explainability of every score
finance.guidance: fabricated customers, fake account numbers/IBANs and randomized transaction histories

insurance.name: Insurance
constraints: fair claims-handling decisions with stated reasons
GDPR minimization of policyholder data
underwriting factors must be disclosed, not hidden
insurance.guidance: invented policyholders, fabricated VINs/property addresses and randomized loss amounts and dates

healthcare.name: Healthcare
constraints: HIPAA de-identification of patient identifiers
no autonomous clinical decisions; human review flag
audit trail for every record change
healthcare.guidance: fictitious Synthea-style patients, diagnoses and lab values with no real MRNs, names or birth dates

manufacturing.name: Manufacturing
constraints: ISO 9001 traceability of quality decisions
safety-critical alerts escalate to a human
units and tolerances validated on input
manufacturing.guidance: physically plausible randomized telemetry, fictitious machine/asset IDs and invented maintenance logs

retail.name: Retail
constraints: GDPR/CCPA consent before personalization
no fabricated reviews or endorsements
price and stock shown must match the catalog
retail.guidance: fictitious catalog with invented SKUs, prices and stock plus synthetic shopper personas

energy.name: Energy and utilities
constraints: NERC CIP-style protection of critical asset identifiers
outage priority must follow declared safety rules
emissions figures carry units and source
energy.guidance: synthetic grid topology, fictitious substation/device IDs and plausible seasonal consumption

public_sector.name: Public sector
constraints: Privacy Act/GDPR protection of citizen PII
decisions explainable for FOIA/open-records review
accessible plain-language outputs (Section 508 spirit)
public_sector.guidance: fabricated citizen personas, invented case numbers and non-traceable addresses

telecom.name: Telecommunications
constraints: GDPR/CCPA protection of subscriber data
data-residency tag respected on every record
billing adjustments require a stated reason
telecom.guidance: fictitious phone numbers/IMEIs, randomized usage volumes and invented support tickets
